name: Chuuzai
source:
The only police officer in the whole of Fujiyoshi.

[Spoiler]His rough exterior hides a sensitive and kind person, with childlike innocence regarding romantic stories.[/spoiler]

He works for [url=/c104999]Higuchi Shouji[/url].
